title: Regular natural SL2 actions on an integral lattice over a commutative base ring
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $L$ a finite-rank free abelian group [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. A homomorphism $\mathrm{SL}_{2,B}\to\mathrm{GL}(L\otimes_{\mathbf Z}B)$ is a family $\rho_A:\mathrm{SL}_2(A)\to\operatorname{Aut}_A(A\otimes_{\mathbf Z}L)$ of group homomorphisms for every commutative $B$-algebra $A$, natural with respect to all $B$-algebra homomorphisms. Here $\mathrm{SL}_2(A)$ is the group of determinant-one two-by-two matrices, with matrix multiplication. The family is regular: in some finite integral basis of $L$, every matrix entry of $\rho_A(g)$ is given, uniformly for all $A,g$, by evaluating a polynomial over $B$ in the four entries of $g$. This is the coordinate-ring description using $B[a,b,c,d]/(ad-bc-1)$; polynomial representatives are not part of the data of a homomorphism. The zero lattice and nonreduced or zero test algebras are allowed. The diagonal point attached to $s\in A^\times$ is $\operatorname{diag}(s,s^{-1})$, equivalently $w(s)w(1)^{-1}$ with $w(s)=x_+(s)x_-(-s^{-1})x_+(s)$.
